incoming_learnings: Trace blocked mandatory pickups to their actual room prerequisite before treating unrelated exhausted supplies as grounds to leave. A key behind summoning quarantine needs explicit preparation planning; delegating a controller is not enough when its equipment and containment checks still reject the observed state.

review.review: The hero was alive at full health when mandatory potion preparation exhausted. Gas became public at decision 189 after exploration opened doorway 673. Decisions 194–208 repeatedly returned toward the gas approach, then reversed into exploration; route-stall recovery did not resolve preparation. Decision 209 stopped without descending. Offline reconstruction using the played source and recorded public inputs matches all 209 selected actions and reasons and reproduces the terminal blocker. Isolated probes show that geometric test banks exist, but protection of the other unknown potion fails: the admitted storage pocket has no sufficiently separated drop site, and ordinary doorway 559 is excluded from storage transit. Returning to the approach therefore does not establish an executable test. No patch is supplied because a safe cross-door storage-and-return transaction is not yet established; changing bank preference or admitting doors alone would bypass independent collateral, arrival and retrieval requirements. The unchanged baseline suite passes 2,414 tests, with four skipped. No potion identity or reward collection is inferred.
review.learnings: Treat a protected reward route and an observation approach as separate from executable potion preparation. Before returning repeatedly, establish a jointly feasible test bank, isolated storage route and fresh-arrival handoff. Preserve mandatory pickup, unknown identities, hazard checks and explicit planner exhaustion.

recommendations.summary: Establish jointly executable gas-test staging and remote potion storage before mandatory discovery exhausts.
evidence: Decision 189, log line 538: gas and protected-room rewards become public at doorway 673; escape returns toward clear ground.
Decisions 194–198, log lines 553–567: gas approach returns alternate with reverse exploration.
Decisions 199 and 207: route-stall recoveries do not repair potion preparation.
Decision 209, log lines 602–604: mandatory preparation exhausts with the hero at 25/25 HP and no accepted descent.
Source-pinned offline reconstruction matches decisions 0–208; isolated decision-195 probes find geometric banks 588 and 646 but no admitted remote potion storage.
recommendations.reason: Revalidated here. Complete source and reconstruction resolve the selecting-state gap, but storage transit remains confined to an eight-cell pocket with no distance-three drop site. Doorway 559 is excluded even when open. No existing transaction proves exterior storage across its reclosure while preserving fresh visibility, frost and flame isolation, and interruption-safe retrieval. Merely admitting doors or changing approach preference is not certified safe. Next derive paired decision-194/195 fixtures around bank 588 and threshold 559, prove a bounded storage-first itinerary with accepted arrival, drop and pickup receipts, then add an original-red/candidate-green regression. Preserve terminal exhaustion and mandatory progression pickup.
